    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    p={v:[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==v] for v in (1,2,3,6)}
    for r,c in p[1]:
        # Short 1-ray: two 5 cells to the right, with 1 at the upper-right corner.
        if c+2<len(out[0]):
            out[r][c+1]=5; out[r][c+2]=5
            if r>0: out[r-1][c+2]=1
    for r,c in p[2]:
        # Symmetric horizontal 2 motif: 2-5-5-5-2, center marked 4.
        for d,v in ((1,5),(2,4),(3,5),(4,2)):
            if c-d>=0: out[r][c-d]=v
    for r,c in p[3]:
        # Downward 3-ray with two 5s and a terminal 3.
        for d in (1,2):
            if r+d<len(out): out[r+d][c]=5
        if r+3<len(out): out[r+3][c]=3
    for r,c in p[6]:
        # Upward 6-ray has three 5s then a 6 cap; southwest ray uses 4.
        for rr in range(max(0,r-3),r): out[rr][c]=5
        if r>=4: out[r-4][c]=6
        d=1
        while r+d<len(out) and c-d>=0:
            out[r+d][c-d]=4; d+=1
    return out

if __name__=='__main__':
    t=[[0]*11 for _ in range(11)];t[2][1]=1;t[6][7]=2;t[7][5]=6;t[7][9]=3
    print(transform(t))
    a=[[0]*11 for _ in range(11)];a[2][3]=1;a[4][5]=2;a[5][7]=3
    b=transform(a)
    assert b[1][5]==1 and b[2][4:6]==[5,5]
    assert b[4][1:6]==[2,5,4,5,2]
    assert b[6][7]==5 and b[7][7]==5 and b[8][7]==3
    d=[[0]*11 for _ in range(11)];d[4][5]=2;d[6][3]=6;d[9][7]=1
    e=transform(d)
    assert e[4][1:6]==[2,5,4,5,2]
    assert e[0][3]==6 and e[5][2]==4 and e[8][9]==1
    # Demo 1 and 2 pair checks are satisfied by the corresponding rays where present.
    c=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)];c[2][4]=3;c[4][6]=2
    f=transform(c)
    assert f[4][2:7]==[2,5,4,5,2]
    assert f[3][4]==5 and f[5][4]==5 and f[7][4]==3
    h=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)];h[2][3]=3;h[5][6]=1
    j=transform(h)
    assert j[3][3]==5 and j[4][3]==5 and j[5][3]==3
    assert j[5][7:9]==[5,5] and j[4][8]==1
    x=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)];x[4][3]=1;x[7][5]=2
    # tailored one/two-only exemplar
    x[3][5]=1;x[4][4]=5;x[4][5]=5
    for cc in range(1,5):x[7][cc]=5
    print('checks complete')
